newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Morgan urges Philippines to tighten rein on money.
newsitem.headline: Morgan urges Philippines to tighten rein on money.

text.p: Morgan Guaranty Trust Co, a unit of J.P. Morgan and Co Inc, has urged the Philippines to keep a tight rein on the country's money supply, a study by its research group released on Monday said.

"While the IMF reserve money growth ceiling of 14.4 percent over a year ago at end-1996 will have been easily met, keeping monetary policy tight becomes the challenge for 1997," Morgan analyst Vicente Low said.
He said the high output growth and a persistent trade deficit "provide compelling reasons for the authorities to favour monetary conservatism," he added.
He said the previous boom-bust cycles of its economy were mostly due to runaway inflation brought about by loose monetary policies.

The country is scheduled to end its programme with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) by the second semester of the year. The IMF has been a staunch proponent of a tight monetary policy in the country.
